# Boot rules

`validateBoot` reports every violation as `- [<id>] <message>`, followed by a `Fix:` and a `Rule:` line that links the entry below. Violations with an `unclassified/<check>` id have no entry yet. `kumiko-schema validate --json` returns the same ids.

## api

| Rule | Summary | Fix | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="api-provider-not-mounted"></a>`api/provider-not-mounted` | The feature exposing a used API is part of the app's feature list. | Register the provider feature in the app's feature list. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/api-ext-rules.ts` |
| <a id="api-provider-not-required"></a>`api/provider-not-required` | A feature using an API lists the exposing feature in requires or optionalRequires. | Add the exposing feature via r.requires({ features: [...] }). | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/api-ext-rules.ts` |
| <a id="api-unknown-api"></a>`api/unknown-api` | Every r.usesApi name is exposed by some mounted feature. | Mount the feature that exposes the API or fix the API name. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/api-ext-rules.ts` |

## boot-check

| Rule | Summary | Fix | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="boot-check-failed"></a>`boot-check/failed` | A feature's r.bootCheck invariant holds for the mounted feature set. | Satisfy the invariant named in the message or unmount the feature that declares it. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/boot-check-rules.ts` |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| <a id="config-edit-field-without-config-key"></a>`config-edit/field-without-config-key` | Every configEdit field maps to a config key in configKeys. | Add the field to configKeys with a <feature>:config:<short> key. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-kind-rules.ts` |
| <a id="config-edit-fields-empty"></a>`config-edit/fields-empty` | A configEdit screen declares at least one field. | Declare at least one field. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-kind-rules.ts` |
| <a id="config-edit-layout-unknown-field"></a>`config-edit/layout-unknown-field` | A configEdit layout names a declared field. | Name a declared field. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-kind-rules.ts` |
| <a id="config-edit-secret-key-unknown-field"></a>`config-edit/secret-key-unknown-field` | secretKeys names declared fields. | Name a declared field. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-kind-rules.ts` |
| <a id="config-edit-write-only-not-encrypted"></a>`config-edit/write-only-not-encrypted` | A writeOnly configEdit field maps to an encrypted config key. | Declare the key with encrypted: true or backing: "secrets". | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-kind-rules.ts` |

| <a id="i18n-missing-settings-hub-key"></a>`i18n/missing-settings-hub-key` | Every translation key the generated settings hub requires is defined. | Add the key via r.translations(...) in the owning feature. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/i18n-keys-rules.ts` |

| <a id="list-facet-unknown-column"></a>`list/facet-unknown-column` | A non-reference facet names a declared column. | Name a declared column or add the column. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-lists-rules.ts` |

## named-filter

| Rule | Summary | Fix | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| <a id="named-filter-stat-navigate-filter-declared"></a>`named-filter/stat-navigate-filter-declared` | A stat navigate.namedFilter is declared in the target screen's namedFilters. | Add { id, label } to namedFilters of the target screen. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/named-filter-rules.ts` |
| <a id="named-filter-stat-navigate-same-named-filter"></a>`named-filter/stat-navigate-same-named-filter` | A stat's params.namedFilter equals navigate.namedFilter. | Set params.namedFilter to the same id as navigate.namedFilter. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/named-filter-rules.ts` |
| <a id="named-filter-stat-navigate-same-query"></a>`named-filter/stat-navigate-same-query` | A stat with navigate counts with the target list's own query. | Set the stat query to the target list's query. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/named-filter-rules.ts` |
| <a id="named-filter-stat-navigate-static-filter"></a>`named-filter/stat-navigate-static-filter` | A stat repeats the target screen's static filter in params.filter. | Set params.filter to the target screen's filter. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/named-filter-rules.ts` |
| <a id="named-filter-stat-navigate-target"></a>`named-filter/stat-navigate-target` | A stat navigate.screen resolves to an entityList or projectionList screen. | Point navigate.screen at a registered list screen. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/named-filter-rules.ts` |

| <a id="pii-personal-jsonb-flag"></a>`pii/personal-jsonb-flag` | A personal jsonb field cannot be sortable, filterable, searchable or lookupable, its value is a ciphertext string. | Remove the flag or the personal annotation. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-jsonb-index"></a>`pii/personal-jsonb-index` | A personal jsonb field is not part of an entity index. | Drop the index or the personal annotation. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-of-invalid-when-absent"></a>`pii/personal-of-invalid-when-absent` | personal.whenAbsent is either "tenant" or "self". | Remove whenAbsent or set it to "tenant" or "self". | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-of-missing-owner-name"></a>`pii/personal-of-missing-owner-name` | personal: { of } names the owner field. | Pass the name of the owner field: personal: { of: "<ownerField>" }. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-of-optional-owner"></a>`pii/personal-of-optional-owner` | An optional owner field of personal: { of } declares a whenAbsent fallback. | Set whenAbsent to "tenant" or "self", or make the owner field required. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-of-owner-type"></a>`pii/personal-of-owner-type` | The owner field named by personal: { of } is a reference or text field. | Use a reference or text field as owner. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-personal-of-unknown-owner"></a>`pii/personal-of-unknown-owner` | The owner field named by personal: { of } exists on the entity. | Point personal.of at an existing field of the entity. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-plaintext-user-reference"></a>`pii/plaintext-user-reference` | A reference to the user entity is never plaintext. | Use the default reference field or personal: "ref" instead of personal: false. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-sensitive-searchable"></a>`pii/sensitive-searchable` | A sensitive field is never searchable. | Drop searchable, or add writeOnly to never return the value. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-sensitive-without-ciphertext"></a>`pii/sensitive-without-ciphertext` | A sensitive field is stored as ciphertext at rest. | Add a subject annotation or encrypted: true. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-subject-key-sortable"></a>`pii/subject-key-sortable` | A field with a subject-key annotation is not sortable, its column is ciphertext. | Drop sortable, use find: "exact" for equality lookups, or keep the field plaintext. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-text-without-personal-stance"></a>`pii/text-without-personal-stance` | Every text and longText field declares whether it holds personal data. | Declare a personal stance, or personal: false with a reason stating why the value is not personal data. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-write-only-conflicting-flag"></a>`pii/write-only-conflicting-flag` | A writeOnly field cannot be defaulted, searched, sorted, filtered or looked up. | Remove either writeOnly or the conflicting flag. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-write-only-embedded-sub-field"></a>`pii/write-only-embedded-sub-field` | writeOnly is only supported on top-level text fields, not on embedded sub-fields. | Remove writeOnly from the sub-field or declare it on a top-level text field. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-write-only-non-text"></a>`pii/write-only-non-text` | writeOnly applies to text fields only. | Use a text field or remove writeOnly. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |
| <a id="pii-write-only-without-sensitive"></a>`pii/write-only-without-sensitive` | A writeOnly field is also sensitive. | Declare the field with find: "secret". | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/pii-retention-rules.ts` |

## screen

| Rule | Summary | Fix | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="screen-action-entity-id-unknown-field"></a>`screen/action-entity-id-unknown-field` | An action's entityId references an existing entity field or the id column. | Point entityId at a known field. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |

| <a id="screen-action-unknown-field-ref"></a>`screen/action-unknown-field-ref` | Action payload and params extractors reference existing entity fields. | Name a known field in the pick/map extractor. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-action-visible-unknown-field"></a>`screen/action-visible-unknown-field` | An action's visible.field references an existing entity field. | Point visible.field at a known field. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-client-action-name"></a>`screen/client-action-name` | A clientAction names its handler as <feature>:<kebab-name>. | Use a name like "auth-email-password:request-password-reset". | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-columns-empty"></a>`screen/columns-empty` | A list screen declares at least one column. | Declare at least one column. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-kind-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-custom-no-component"></a>`screen/custom-no-component` | A custom screen renderer declares a react or native component. | Set react or native on the renderer. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-custom-write-qn-unregistered"></a>`screen/custom-write-qn-unregistered` | Every dispatcher.write QN in app source names a registered write handler. | Check the spelling against registered write handlers (<feature>:write:<handler>). | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-detail-for-duplicate"></a>`screen/detail-for-duplicate` | At most one screen declares detailFor for an entity. | Keep detailFor on one screen per entity. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-detail-for-unknown-entity"></a>`screen/detail-for-unknown-entity` | detailFor names an entity a feature registers. | Set detailFor to a registered entity name or remove it. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-drawer-target-not-action-form"></a>`screen/drawer-target-not-action-form` | A drawer action targets an actionForm screen. | Point screen at an actionForm screen, or use kind: navigate for a full-page target. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-drawer-target-unresolved"></a>`screen/drawer-target-unresolved` | A drawer action targets a registered screen of the same feature. | Point screen at a screen declared in the same feature. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-edit-field-condition-function"></a>`screen/edit-field-condition-function` | Edit field visible, readOnly and required are FieldConditions, not functions. | Use a FieldCondition (boolean or { field, eq/ne/in/notIn }). | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-entity-not-declared"></a>`screen/entity-not-declared` | A screen's entity is declared in its feature. | Declare the entity in this feature or fix the name. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-kind-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-fallback-has-visible-when"></a>`screen/fallback-has-visible-when` | A fallback target has no visibleWhen of its own. | Point fallback at a screen without visibleWhen. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-fallback-map-empty"></a>`screen/fallback-map-empty` | A fallback map names at least one reason. | Set at least one fallback reason or use a screen id string. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-fallback-self"></a>`screen/fallback-self` | A screen's fallback points at a different screen. | Point fallback at a different screen. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-fallback-unknown-reason"></a>`screen/fallback-unknown-reason` | Fallback map keys are known fallback reasons. | Use only the documented fallback reasons. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-fallback-without-visible-when"></a>`screen/fallback-without-visible-when` | A screen with a fallback also declares visibleWhen. | Add visibleWhen or remove fallback. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-filter-in-needs-array"></a>`screen/filter-in-needs-array` | A filter with op in has an array value. | Pass an array as filter.value. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-kind-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-header-action-row-click"></a>`screen/header-action-row-click` | Record header actions do not set rowClick, because a record screen has no row. | Remove rowClick. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-kind-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-nav-target-unresolved"></a>`screen/nav-target-unresolved` | A redirect, cancelTarget, success link or fallback resolves to a registered screen. | Use the id of a screen in this feature or a fully-qualified <feature>:screen:<id>. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-navigate-entity-target-needs-entity-id"></a>`screen/navigate-entity-target-needs-entity-id` | An entity navigate-target on a non-entityList screen sets an explicit entityId. | Set entityId on the navigate action. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-navigate-entity-target-no-detail"></a>`screen/navigate-entity-target-no-detail` | An entity navigate-target has a screen declaring detailFor for that entity. | Add detailFor to a screen of the entity or navigate to a screen directly. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-navigate-params-dashboard-key-mismatch"></a>`screen/navigate-params-dashboard-key-mismatch` | Navigate params extract at least one key the target dashboard reads (filter id, time range id or record param). | Fix the params extractor to produce one of the dashboard's read keys, or remove it. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-navigate-params-dashboard-no-reader"></a>`screen/navigate-params-dashboard-no-reader` | A navigate action with params targets a dashboard that declares a filter, time range or record binding. | Remove the params extractor, or add a filter (or record binding) to the target dashboard. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-navigate-params-target-ignores-params"></a>`screen/navigate-params-target-ignores-params` | Navigate params only target screens that read URL search params as initial values (actionForm, secretMint, entityEdit-create). | Remove the params extractor or retarget to an actionForm, secretMint or cross-entity entityEdit-create screen. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-navigate-tab-target-not-tabbed"></a>`screen/navigate-tab-target-not-tabbed` | A navigate tab targets a projectionDetail screen with layout.mode tabs. | Remove the tab or navigate to a projectionDetail screen with layout.mode tabs. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-navigate-tab-target-unresolved"></a>`screen/navigate-tab-target-unresolved` | A navigate action with tab has a navigate-target that resolves to a screen. | Point the navigate-target at a registered screen. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-navigate-tab-unknown-section"></a>`screen/navigate-tab-unknown-section` | A navigate tab names a section id of the target screen. | Use one of the target screen's section ids. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-navigate-target-neither-screen-nor-entity"></a>`screen/navigate-target-neither-screen-nor-entity` | A navigate action sets exactly one of screen and entity. | Set screen or entity on the navigate action. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-navigate-target-screen-and-entity"></a>`screen/navigate-target-screen-and-entity` | A navigate action sets either screen or entity, not both. | Remove one of screen and entity. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-navigate-target-unresolved"></a>`screen/navigate-target-unresolved` | A navigate screen target resolves to a registered screen in any feature. | Use "<feature>:screen:<id>" of an existing screen. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-prefill-param-not-rendered"></a>`screen/prefill-param-not-rendered` | Prefill params only name fields the target form renders in its layout. | Add the field to the target layout or remove the param. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-prefill-param-sensitive-field"></a>`screen/prefill-param-sensitive-field` | Prefill params never name sensitive or password fields of the target form. | Remove the param or prefill a non-sensitive field. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-prefill-param-unknown-field"></a>`screen/prefill-param-unknown-field` | Prefill params only name fields the target form declares. | Name a field the target form declares, or remove the param. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-primary-action-unknown"></a>`screen/primary-action-unknown` | primaryAction and inlineActions name a declared action id or the default edit. | Use a declared action id, or "edit" when the screen sets detailFor. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |

| <a id="screen-redirect-id-from-whitespace"></a>`screen/redirect-id-from-whitespace` | A redirect idFrom has no leading or trailing whitespace. | Remove the whitespace from idFrom. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-redirect-on-list-row-action"></a>`screen/redirect-on-list-row-action` | List and related-list row actions do not set redirect. | Remove redirect; it is only honored on record actions. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-actions-rules.ts` |
| <a id="screen-renderer-function"></a>`screen/renderer-function` | Field and column renderers are FormatSpecs, not functions. | Use a FormatSpec ({ format: "..." }). | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-rules.ts` |

| <a id="screen-submit-prefilled-hidden-required"></a>`screen/submit-prefilled-hidden-required` | With submitPrefilled, a hidden required field is passed in by a navigate action's params. | Add the field to the params of a navigate action targeting the screen, make it visible, or drop required. | `packages/framework/src/engine/boot-validator/screens-rules.ts` |
